title: Travel Japanese
blurb: This is the one track you can use on day one — nothing in it needs grammar beyond N5, because travel Japanese is a small set of fixed phrases plus the nerve to say them.

title: Real Casual Japanese
blurb: Textbook Japanese is polite Japanese, and polite Japanese holds people at a distance.

title: Sounds and counting
blurb: Two things textbooks skim over and Japanese people use in every other sentence.

title: Dialects 方言
blurb: Textbooks teach 標準語, and then you meet someone from Osaka and catch about half of it.

title: Business Japanese
blurb: Workplace Japanese is not harder vocabulary — it is a different register.

title: Academic Japanese
blurb: Academic Japanese is not the Japanese you already know made harder — it is two registers you switch between.
